mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_ai_call WHERE call_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT * FROM kb_ai_call WHERE call_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_ai_call (call_id, registration_digest, mode, turn_id, user_id, department_id, protocol_version, started_at, initiated_at, epoch, generation_status, settlement_policy, settlement_status, lease_until, quota_intended) VALUES (CAST(#{callId} AS uuid), #{registrationDigest}, #{mode}, CAST(#{turnId} AS uuid), #{userId}, #{departmentId}, #{protocolVersion}, #{startedAt}, #{initiatedAt}, #{epoch}, #{generationStatus}, #{settlementPolicy}, #{settlementStatus}, #{leaseUntil}, #{quotaIntended})
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_ai_call SET epoch = #{epoch}, version = version + 1, generation_status = #{generationStatus}, result_code = #{resultCode}, usage_status = #{usageStatus}, prompt_tokens = #{promptTokens}, completion_tokens = #{completionTokens}, quota_intended = #{quotaIntended}, model_dispatch_intent = #{modelDispatchIntent}, lease_id = CAST(#{leaseId} AS uuid), reserved_tokens = #{reservedTokens}, planned_charged_tokens = #{plannedChargedTokens}, settlement_status = #{settlementStatus}, finalized_at = #{finalizedAt}, settled_at = #{settledAt}, retention_anchor_at = #{retentionAnchorAt}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil} WHERE call_id = CAST(#{callId} AS uuid) AND version = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT *, payload::text AS payload FROM kb_ai_call_event WHERE event_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
SELECT *, payload::text AS payload FROM kb_ai_call_event WHERE call_id = CAST(#{call} AS uuid) AND kind = #{kind}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_ai_call_event (event_id, call_id, kind, payload_digest, occurred_at, payload) VALUES (CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid), CAST(#{callId} AS uuid), #{kind}, #{payloadDigest}, #{occurredAt}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM kb_ai_call WHERE mode = 'SINGLE' AND generation_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_until, id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_ai_call_event WHERE call_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
DELETE FROM kb_ai_call WHERE call_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.select: SELECT GREATEST(c.started_at, (SELECT MAX(e.occurred_at) FROM kb_ai_call_event e WHERE e.call_id = c.call_id)) FROM kb_ai_call c WHERE c.call_id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_ai_observation_coverage SET history_cleared_through = GREATEST(history_cleared_through, #{through}) WHERE singleton_id = 1
mapper.select: SELECT history_cleared_through FROM kb_ai_observation_coverage WHERE singleton_id = 1
mapper.sql: COUNT(*) AS "callCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE model_dispatch_intent) AS "modelDispatchCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_status = 'KNOWN') AS "knownCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_status = 'UNKNOWN') AS "unknownCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE usage_status = 'NOT_INVOKED') AS "notInvokedCount", SUM(prompt_tokens::numeric) FILTER (WHERE usage_status = 'KNOWN') AS "promptTokens", SUM(completion_tokens::numeric) FILTER (WHERE usage_status = 'KNOWN') AS "completionTokens", COALESCE(SUM(planned_charged_tokens::numeric), 0) AS "plannedChargedTokens", COALESCE(SUM(planned_charged_tokens::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'SETTLED'), 0) AS "settledChargedTokens", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'RUNNING') AS "runningCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'COMPLETED') AS "completedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'FAILED') AS "failedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'CANCELLED') AS "cancelledCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'INTERRUPTED') AS "interruptedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE generation_status = 'REJECTED') AS "rejectedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'RESERVED') AS "reservedCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'NOT_REQUIRED') AS "notRequiredCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'SETTLED') AS "settledCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'PENDING') AS "pendingCount", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE settlement_status = 'REVIEW') AS "reviewCount"
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_ai_collection_period (opened_at, retention_days) VALUES (#{now}, #{days}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_ai_collection_period SET closed_at = GREATEST(opened_at, #{now}) WHERE closed_at IS NULL
UPDATE kb_ai_collection_period SET closed_at = GREATEST(opened_at, #{now}) WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND retention_days <> #{days}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM kb_ai_observation_instance WHERE instance_id IN (SELECT instance_id FROM kb_ai_observation_instance WHERE lease_until <= #{now} ORDER BY lease_until LIMIT 500)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_ai_observation_instance VALUES (CAST(#{id} AS uuid), #{enabled}, #{days}, #{until}) ON CONFLICT (instance_id) DO UPDATE SET enabled = EXCLUDED.enabled, retention_days = EXCLUDED.retention_days, lease_until = EXCLUDED.lease_until
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM kb_ai_observation_instance WHERE lease_until > #{now} AND (enabled <> #{enabled} OR retention_days <> #{days})
